event.title: Teenager Commits Deadly Shooting at School After Killing Grandparents in Thailand
event.canonical_title: Teenager Commits Deadly Shooting at School After Killing Grandparents in Thailand
event.summary: A 14-year-old boy in Thailand killed his grandparents before opening fire at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, resulting in at least eight deaths, including his own. The attack, which occurred just outside Bangkok, left more than 30 others injured. Authorities reported that the boy used a firearm belonging to his grandfather and fired a total of 26 rounds during the incident. The motive for the shooting remains unclear.

timeline.title: Deadly School Shooting in Thailand Leaves Multiple Victims
timeline.summary: A tragic shooting incident occurred at the Debsirin Nonthaburi School near Bangkok, where a 14-year-old boy killed at least seven people, including five school staff members, and wounded over 30 others before taking his own life. The shooter had previously fatally shot his grandparents. The event has raised concerns about gun violence in Thailand, prompting calls for stricter gun laws.

timeline.title: Death Toll Rises to Nine in Thailand School Shooting as 12-Year-Old Girl Dies
timeline.summary: A 12-year-old girl has died from critical injuries sustained during a school shooting in Nonthaburi province, Thailand, raising the death toll to at least nine. The shooting, which occurred on Friday, involved a 14-year-old assailant who also reportedly killed his grandparents before opening fire at Debsirin Nonthaburi School. The shooter is believed to have taken his own life following the attack.

timeline.title: Thai Prime Minister Suspends Firearm Licences Following School Shooting
timeline.summary: In response to a recent school shooting, Thailand's Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has suspended all firearms licences. This decision comes as the bodies of the teenage shooter and his grandparents, whom he killed, were cremated. The Prime Minister also emphasized the need for stricter controls and harsher penalties for firearms-related offenses.
